title: 高盛Andrew Tilton：AI红利席卷亚太，台湾GDP增长7-8个百分点？
speaker: Andrew Tilton

segments.en: Andrew, we woke up this morning and one of the things I wasn't expecting to talk about, we ended up doing so because of such a strong number, was the U.S. PMI numbers. The reason I just bring it up is a lot of the strength in the U.S. economy and part of the capics is coming this way. And a lot of these economies in the Asia Pacific are just realizing the tailwinds and feeling the tailwinds from the U.S. Talk us through that, the AI dividend that we're seeing across supply chains here.
segments.zh: Andrew，我们今天早上醒来，因为一个非常强劲的数据，我们最终谈到了美国PMI数据。我提到这个是因为美国经济的许多强劲表现以及部分资本支出正朝这个方向来。亚太许多经济体正在意识到并感受到来自美国的顺风。请给我们讲讲我们在供应链中看到的AI红利。

segments.en: It's been the biggest upside surprise to the region this year. Back in March and April, we were worried about the growth that looked given the higher energy prices coming from the Middle East, but in many places we've seen significant surprises to the upside.
segments.zh: 这是今年该地区最大的上行惊喜。早在3月和4月，我们担心来自中东的更高能源价格会影响增长，但在许多地方我们看到了显著的上行惊喜。

segments.en: And I think the way to think about this is two thirds of a data center investment is equipment coming from Asia. So there's an enormous pull to tech exports from this region given the very high level of hyperscaler and broader capics in the AI investment boom.
segments.zh: 我认为思考方式是，数据中心投资的三分之二是来自亚洲的设备。因此，鉴于AI投资热潮中超大规模云厂商和更广泛资本支出的极高水平，该地区的科技出口受到巨大拉动。

segments.en: We think that this year Taiwan alone will get about seven to eight percentage points of GDP growth just from tech exports. So it's incredible boost. And as you mentioned earlier, it'll be double digit overall GDP growth, the vast majority of that tech exports.
segments.zh: 我们认为今年仅台湾就将从科技出口获得约7到8个百分点的GDP增长。这是惊人的提振。正如你之前提到的，整体GDP增长将达到两位数，其中绝大部分来自科技出口。

segments.en: But also places that are a little bit less on the radar, Malaysia, Singapore, Vietnam, playing various roles in the broader tech supply chain. And of course, Korea probably seeing two to three percentage points of boost from its memory chip exports.
segments.zh: 但也有一些不太受关注的地方，马来西亚、新加坡、越南，在更广泛的科技供应链中扮演各种角色。当然，韩国可能从其存储芯片出口中获得2到3个百分点的提振。

segments.en: So this is a huge wave of demand that's pushing up exports in the region. I think the second wave of that is really what's happening to domestic demand in these places, particularly in Korea and Taiwan. We're seeing domestic investment picking up to build capacity.
segments.zh: 所以这是一波巨大的需求浪潮，推高了该地区的出口。我认为第二波实际上是这些地方国内需求的变化，尤其是韩国和台湾。我们看到国内投资正在回升以建设产能。

segments.en: There's a windfall of tax revenues for the governments. So that's resulting in faster government spending growth. And so those things, while smaller than the export boost, are also helping regional activity. Okay. And what perhaps we have it discussed maybe for next time is what about those economies, not part of the AI supply chain?
segments.zh: 政府获得了税收意外收入。这导致政府支出增长加快。因此，这些虽然比出口提振小，但也在帮助区域活动。好的。也许我们下次可以讨论那些不在AI供应链中的经济体。
